property: When a command lane has capacity one, a second command callback cannot start while the first remains active.
harm: Two commands in the same lane could modify shared session state at the same time.
bounds: One lane, three commands, capacity fixed at one.
All legal orders of the three enqueue events and three settlement events, with each settlement either fulfilling or rejecting.
assumptions: Each event is followed by an event-loop turn so the command queue can drain pending microtasks.
Each queued command has equal priority and uses a controlled promise inside the real enqueue API.
exclusions: Gateway restarts, dynamic capacity, grouped lanes, task timeouts, abort signals, and four or more commands.

source.meaning: The drain loop evaluates capacity before admitting the next callback.
Admission accounts for active work before invoking callbacks.
Settlement releases capacity before pumping the same lane.
The check enqueues real callbacks through this public API.
Equal-priority commands enter the production queue used in the exploration.

mutation.meaning: Permit a new admission even when every slot in the lane is occupied.
